description: Fetch one Appraisily public /artist page by slug, artist URL, or search query. Returns name, public page URL, aliases, genres, market summary, recent sold lots, top houses, related artists, and page extras such as birth/death years. Use after search_artists when the user needs one artist page. This is market context, not a signed appraisal or authentication.

artistUrl.description: Public Appraisily /artist URL for one artist.

query.description: Artist name used when a slug is not known.

name: get_artist
title: Get Artist Page
